assessment_history.summary: The PRD for "spec_generation_improvement" is well-structured and thorough. All four required/expected sections (Intent, Goals, Non-Goals, Background) are present and of high quality. The Intent is concise and clearly articulates the problem being solved. The Background provides concrete, quantified evidence motivating the change. Goals are specific and implementation-oriented. Non-Goals draw clear scope boundaries. Beyond the core sections, the PRD includes a detailed Technical Specification covering splitting heuristics, validation rules, output model changes, and impact on existing rules — giving implementors strong guidance. The Clarifications section preemptively resolves likely ambiguities. This PRD is ready to proceed to artifact generation.
